CREATE TEMP TABLE cc_undo ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT id, "articleNumber" AS now_number, "articleBis" AS now_bis, CASE WHEN id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%' THEN NULL WHEN "articleBis" = 100 THEN "articleNumber" WHEN "articleNumber" BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN "articleNumber" - 1 WHEN "articleNumber" BETWEEN 27 AND 94 THEN "articleNumber" - 2 END AS old_number FROM legal_articles WHERE "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND (("articleBis" = 0 AND "articleNumber" BETWEEN 18 AND 94) OR "articleBis" = 100)

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM cc_undo) = 81 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM cc_undo WHERE old_number IS NULL) = 4 AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT old_number) FROM cc_undo) = 77 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_undo_size

UPDATE legal_article_case_links k SET "articleId" = u.id, "updatedAt" = now() FROM legal_articles c, cc_undo u WHERE k."articleId" = c.id AND c."lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND c."articleBis" = 0 AND c."articleNumber" BETWEEN 18 AND 94 AND u.old_number = c."articleNumber" AND u.id <> c.id
UPDATE legal_graph_nodes g SET "articleId" = u.id FROM cc_undo u WHERE g.law = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية' AND g.number BETWEEN 18 AND 94 AND u.old_number = g.number AND g."articleId" <> u.id
UPDATE legal_thesaurus_occurrences o SET article_number = u.old_number FROM cc_undo u WHERE o.article_id = u.id AND u.old_number IS NOT NULL AND o.article_number IS DISTINCT FROM u.old_number
DELETE FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source = 'boe' AND action IN ('insert', 'renumber', 'non_article') AND entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM cc_undo)
DELETE FROM embeddings WHERE owner_id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%'

SELECT 1 / (CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_article_case_links WHERE "articleId" LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_graph_nodes WHERE "articleId" LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_versions WHERE article_id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_amendments WHERE "articleId" LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_thesaurus_occurrences WHERE article_id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE entity_id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_inserted_free
DELETE FROM legal_articles WHERE id LIKE 'hkm28-cc-%' AND "lawName" = 'نظام المحاكم التجارية'
UPDATE legal_articles a SET "articleNumber" = a."articleNumber" + 100000 FROM cc_undo u WHERE a.id = u.id AND u.now_bis = 0 AND u.old_number IS NOT NULL

UPDATE legal_articles a SET "articleNumber" = u.old_number, title = 'المادة ' || u.old_number, search_norm = 'نظام المحاكم التجاريه' || ' الماده ' || u.old_number || ' ' || substr(a.search_norm, length('نظام المحاكم التجاريه' || ' الماده ' || u.now_number || ' ') + 1), "updatedAt" = now() FROM cc_undo u WHERE a.id = u.id AND a."articleNumber" >= 100000
